previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring and pain management following a flexible bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of airway stenoses due to relapsing polychondritis and ___ syndrome. The procedure successfully dilated the left main stem bronchus to 9mm and the bronchus intermedius to 4mm, with no complications. He remained hemodynamically stable, with oxygen saturations at 98–100% on 40% trach mask. Post-procedural pain was managed with oxycodone and acetaminophen. He was educated on adrenal insufficiency risks due to chronic prednisone use, including the need to triple his dose during illness and the use of a Solu-Cortef injection in emergencies. He was discharged home with a short course of oxycodone, instructions to continue all home medications, and follow-up appointments scheduled with interventional pulmonology and rheumatology.
